reconfigure.title: Edit asset
reconfigure.description:
Set the interval for each task. Leave a field empty to ignore that unit. Each task needs at least one interval.

Fields are named <task>_<unit>, where unit is months, days or km:
{tasks}

To add a task, fill in its name and at least one interval.

error.no_trigger: Each task needs at least one interval.
